title: Rooftop Courier
tagline: It's the only game where you race the sunrise to deliver every letter.
how_to_play: Arrow keys or A and D to run, Space to jump, E to read signs.

endings.title: The golden stamp
endings.text: With the golden stamp on the last letter, every window on the street lights up at once.

endings.title: Delivered
endings.text: The last letter drops into the post box just as the sun comes up over the chimneys.
